column4: Legacy host/kernel and public API declaration baseline
Remove unused raw stop/static-dispatch C exports and enforce declaration identity
Remove host-internal engine entry points and dead VM queries from the synchronized host/kernel ABI
Separate the kernel identity from the installed API and remove unused execution-engine controls
Preserve execute-fault direction and make interrupt-token registration report failure
Report guest PC-alignment exceptions without terminating the host emulator
Allow each supported address-space profile to place the synthetic signal-return trampoline at its task ceiling
Wake active and tickless-idle fixed vCPU carriers for a public host stop
Name the virtual CPU from the emulator so every guest architecture reports one model
Deliver data-alignment faults as SIGBUS at the effective data address
Invalidate translated code in another process after Linux writes its text
Commit and release guest RAM on demand so a released range leaves the host footprint and is wired again before reuse
